title: Self-Consistent Adjoint Policy Iteration for Constrained Dynamic Portfolio Choice
summary: We develop simulation-based policy iteration for continuous-time portfolio choice with predictable returns and convex constraints. Each outer step re-evaluates a fixed-latent open-loop backpropagation-through-time (OL-BPTT) adjoint after deployment and solves the constrained update. Shifted-adjoint cancellation controls the adjoint--HJB Hamiltonian-gradient discrepancy by the policy-improvement residual.
